question: On 25 August 2023, which State Government expanded its ongoing 'Breakfast Scheme' for students of classes 1 to 5, studying in 31,008 government schools across the State?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Tamil Nadu government expanded its **Breakfast Scheme** on 25 August 2023 to cover students of classes 1 to 5 in **31,008 government schools** across the state.
 
• This initiative aims to improve student attendance, reduce dropout rates, and enhance the overall nutritional status of children.
 
• The scheme provides a nutritious morning meal to children, addressing the issue of hunger and its impact on learning outcomes.
 
• Originally launched in 2022 for students of classes 1 to 5 in select schools, the program has now been scaled up to reach a significantly larger number of beneficiaries.
 
• The program has been widely praised as a pioneering step in ensuring **child welfare and education**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mid-Day Meal Scheme:**

 
 
• India’s Mid-Day Meal (MDM) Scheme was launched in 1995 to provide free lunches to schoolchildren in government schools.
 
• The scheme aims to improve **nutritional levels, school attendance, and learning outcomes** for children.
 
• It is the largest school meal program in the world.
 
• In Tamil Nadu, the MDM scheme was introduced as early as 1925, making it a pioneer in this area.
 
 
 
• **Right to Education Act (RTE):**
 
 
• The RTE Act, 2009, ensures free and compulsory education for children aged 6 to 14 years in India.
 
• It emphasizes the importance of eliminating barriers like hunger, poverty, and lack of infrastructure in education.
 
 
 
• **Nutrition and Learning:**
 
 
• Studies show that children who receive proper nutrition perform better in academics due to improved concentration and energy levels.
 
• Programs like the Breakfast Scheme contribute significantly to addressing malnutrition and hunger among school-going children.
 
 
 
• **Tamil Nadu’s Welfare Programs:**
 
 
• Tamil Nadu has been a frontrunner in implementing social welfare schemes, including free textbooks, uniforms, and cycles for students.
 
• The state’s focus on education and health has been instrumental in improving human development indicators.
